credits.title: Wolf Creek: Legacy
credits.overview: A family of American tourists wander innocently into Taylor's hunting grounds. When the parents sacrifice themselves to save their children, the kids find themselves alone, lost and hunted in the vast Australian wilderness.

credits.title: Wolfram
credits.overview: 1930s Australia, the colonial frontier: two swaggering outlaws roll into a mining town and unleash a wave of cruelty, leading three kids to break free from their white masters and set off across the 'sweet country' of central Australia in search of a safe home.

credits.title: Purity
credits.overview: When her rebellious older sister returns to their Australian coastal town for Christmas, Marianne is torn between her mother's conservatism and a new idea of womanhood.

credits.title: Yakka
credits.overview: As two teenage brothers get up to mischief on summer holidays in a coastal fishing town, the cycles of toxic masculinity above the water reflect the hierarchies of predation below.

credits.title: Lonesome
credits.overview: Casey, a country lad running from a small-town scandal, finds himself down and out in big city Sydney. When he meets city lad Tib both men find something they have been missing but neither of them knows quite how to negotiate it.

credits.title: The Stranger
credits.overview: Two strangers strike up a conversation on a long journey. However, neither is who they appear to be, each carry secrets that threaten to ruin them — and in the background, one of the nation's largest police operations is closing in.

credits.title: Basil: Parts 1 & 2
credits.overview: Basil is an ongoing 16mm film, currently comprised of two chapters — the first shot in 2012, the second in 2019. The third chapter in the triptych is slated to be shot in 2026. All three chapters will eventually be merged together to make a single piece spanning fifteen years.

credits.title: We Have Me
credits.overview: When a high school basketball captain is faced with suspension for breaking school property, a young girl with down syndrome takes him under her wing in order to win a dance competition and pay for the damages.

credits.title: I Met a Girl
credits.overview: An aspiring musician struggling with schizophrenia falls for a mysterious woman who may be all in his head. When she suddenly vanishes, he takes off on a cross-country journey across Australia to find her, forcing his long-suffering brother to chase after him.

credits.title: My First Panic
credits.overview: On her way home from a night of hedonistic partying, Ruby, an anxious young woman experiences her first panic attack. With every new environment her panic escalates, and with each person she encounters unable to help, Ruby is forced to face the relentlessness of her anxiety disorder.

credits.title: True History of the Kelly Gang
credits.overview: Set against the badlands of Australia where the English rule with a bloody fist and the Irish endure, Ned Kelly discovers he comes from a line of Irish rebels — an uncompromising army of cross dressing bandits immortalised for terrorising their oppressors back in Ireland. credits.title: Backpedal
credits.overview: A collage of an American poem, exploring the universality of womanhood.

credits.title: Three Stories Inside a Rental Van
credits.overview: The life of a white rental van is told in three parts via the different people who hire it.

credits.title: Sweet Country
credits.overview: In 1929, an Australian Aboriginal stockman kills a white station owner in self-defense and goes on the lam, pursued by a posse.

credits.title: Wolf
credits.overview: One day in the squat, Wolf finds an abandoned baby and she is faced with a decision that changes both their lives.

credits.title: Teenage Kicks
credits.overview: Miklós is at the age when everything feels high-stakes. He is coming to terms with his own sexuality, and when his best friend Dan reveals that he has a new girlfriend, this puts an end to their plans to run away together.

credits.title: Johnny Ghost
credits.overview: Millicent, a professional musician, wants to get her old commemorative tattoo removed, but the ghosts of her post-punk past wont let her go so easily.'

credits.title: Sleeping Beauty
credits.overview: A haunting erotic fairytale about Lucy, a young University student drawn into a mysterious hidden world of beauty and desire.

credits.title: The Clinic
credits.overview: While traveling across country with her fiancé, Beth wakes alone in an isolated clinic to a mother's worst nightmare. Just how far will she go to save her child?

credits.title: 3 Acts of Murder
credits.overview: In 1928 Arthur Upfield, Australia’s premier crime writer, plotted the perfect murder for his novel The Sands of Windee. credits.title: Prime Mover
credits.overview: A long haul truckie who finds that the reality of his existence is far removed from his youthful dreams of owning and driving his own prime mover.

credits.title: Candy
credits.overview: A poet falls in love with an art student, who gravitates to his bohemian lifestyle — and his love of heroin. Hooked as much on one another as they are on the drug, their relationship alternates between states of oblivion, self-destruction, and despair.

credits.title: Queen of the Damned
credits.overview: Vampire Lestat awakens from his slumber and becomes a rock star. But chaos strikes when his music awakens Akasha, the vampire queen, who may not rest until she makes Lestat her new king.

credits.title: Strange Fits of Passion
credits.overview: The hilarious tale of one young woman's quest to lose her virginity. She is a sexually curious, romantically frustrated bookstore clerk on a mission. credits.overview: In the 1930s tensions between the government and the Indigenous peoples of Australia's north were on a knife-edge. credits.title: Bigger Than Tina
credits.overview: The story of Dan Vardy-Cobb as he aspires to become a pop star.

credits.title: To Have and to Hold
credits.overview: An Australian widower living in New Guinea starts a relationship with a woman very similar to his much-beloved wife, but their life together turns out to be far from the imagined romantic ideal.

credits.title: Lessons in the Language of Love
credits.overview: Two people meet, they connect. One disconnects, the other can't and then it's all over. The definitive guide to a language harder to learn than Votyak but much more important.

credits.title: Cody: A Family Affair
credits.overview: Cody and Fiorelli try to catch diamond smugglers, but the gems are not where they were supposed to be. Cody embarks to infiltrate the dealers who brought the diamonds in from South Africa. He also searches for a missing teenager.

credits.overview: NASA's Tidbinbilla Tracking station in Australia prepares for the re-entry of a decaying satellite containing a dangerous biological experiment.
